pr_title: Handle beatmaps with too many difficulties
pr_body:
Fixes #4929. - [x] Depends on #5067 I am creating this draft PR because I am not sure I will be able to finish it, but I would like to share the progress I already managed to do. Commits so far:
08aba7d: Makes wrapping work

But as it can be seen, text overlap on the left side, and on the right side, that rightmost difficulty is hidden by the "play preview" button part. ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17320094/59414879-b452ae00-8dc2-11e9-90b9-01088b175fb2.png)

70e7f65 : Fixes overlapping

But the play preview button hide problem is still present, and another problem arises: the favourite/download button is cropped. ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17320094/59415118-29be7e80-8dc3-11e9-912f-da8f771c5df9.png)

The fav/DL button crop issue happens only if there are more than one rows of difficulties, most likely because in `osu.Game.Overlays.BeatmapSet.Header.cs`'s constructor, `Height` is set to the static value of `400`. But if I remove that and try to play with `AutoSizeAxes` / `RelativeSizeAxes` properties, the content simply does not show at all. This is where I am now and I am experimenting, and of course I would accept help if someone knows the solution.
pr_comments: The content "doesn't show" if you set the Header to `AutoSizeAxes` because its children all have `RelativeSizeAxes` set to `Axes.Y` which makes them depend on the Header's height, you can simply fix that by making the children use `AutoSizeAxes = Axes.Y`
Does not address the direct overlay portion of the issue I just discovered.
This does not need to be pending any new design. As long as it behaves in line with the web, it should be fine.
Everything will be reviewed as time allows. Please have some patience, there's no need to mention specific people.
This is not a straightforward nor high priority change. There are 94 PRs pending review. They will be attended to in order of priority and ease-of-merging.
@arphox could you please bring this PR up-to-date?

> @arphox could you please bring this PR up-to-date?

I'll do that.
@peppy Done, I've updated the branch and also refactored it a bit.
Please split this out into two separate PRs (one for the overlay change and one for the song select change). This is too complicated for a single PR.
@peppy About the image, is there a problem with that or were you expecting wrapped icons?
Nevermind, the design UX is just bad.
Can be closed as split into #5821 and #5823
Closing in favour of split PRs

issue_context.title: Difficulties do not wrap correctly on the BeatmapSetOverlay or DirectOverlay
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** 
On sets with the 21 or more difficulties (e.g. Sotark's Quaver) difficulties flow off the right-hand side of the screen.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
![osu_2019-06-05_12-12-06](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6157330/58975711-420f1780-878b-11e9-9385-c21f54c83d0d.png)


**osu!lazer version:** 
2019.530.0
